goal: Descend through the Stores, clear the Inner Redoubt, and secure its final exit. Keys and counterweights open protected routes; caches support the return journey.
successText: The expedition has secured the inner position. The route is open and the surviving party can withdraw.
defeatText: The party has fallen. Load your last save, retry this seed, or start a new expedition. Your previous save is kept until you save again.

difficulties.name: Normal
difficulties.description: Standard enemy pressure with time to recover between fights.

difficulties.name: Hard
difficulties.description: Heavier incoming damage; use cover and recovery carefully.
